description:
A facilities management technician needs to clean up the Emoncms feed list after commissioning a building's energy monitoring system. Delete exactly 4 test feeds from the feed list while preserving all production feeds.

The feeds to DELETE are:
- test_voltage_check
- test_ct_sensor_1
- test_calibration_run
- test_mqtt_connection

All other feeds must remain untouched. Navigate to the Feeds page (already open), locate each test feed, and delete it using the feed list interface. Confirm each deletion when prompted.

After completing the deletions, the feed list should contain only the production monitoring feeds.
